intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Takwa. We are deeply committed to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring a secure experience. This policy outlines how we protect and manage your information with the utmost care.

collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
collect.content: We only collect information essential to providing our services, such as your authentication details and geographical location for spiritual accuracy.
items: Personal Data: Secure registration via Supabase or Google authentication.
Location Data: Necessary for calculating precise prayer times and Qibla direction.
Usage Data: Anonymized technical insights to enhance the application's performance.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.content: Your data is used exclusively to facilitate your spiritual practices and improve our offerings.
items: Providing and refining our core services.
Ensuring the highest precision in prayer times.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We partner with industry-leading services like Supabase and Google to ensure robust security and reliability. These partners maintain their own rigorous privacy standards.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement state-of-the-art security measures, honoring the trust you place in us to keep your spiritual journey private.

contact.content: For any privacy-related inquiries, please contact our dedicated support team at:

use.title: 2. Use of Services
use.content: You agree to use Takwa for lawful and spiritual purposes, respecting the community and the sanctity of the services provided.

disclaimer.title: 4. Disclaimer
